0022600190.text: Brooklyn (2-6, 13th in the East, currently on a one-game win streak) visits Atlanta (5-4, first in the Southeast, on a two-game win streak) in the Nets' ninth game of the season. The Nets are 1-3 on the road, and Egor Demin is out with a bruised leg while Noah Clowney is day-to-day with knee soreness and a game-time decision, and Atlanta is without Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (fractured foot). The teams have not met yet this season, and Brooklyn lost all four games of the 2025-26 series, most recently a 141-107 defeat in Brooklyn on April 3, 2026.
